ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; pixel data is predominantly low-intensity (dark pigmentation) occupying approximately 92% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized in micro-clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across the primary fluke body; white high-contrast mottling is localized at the distal tips and in sparse clusters along the peripheral margins of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression at the center; the angle of intersection between lobe margins is approximately 60 degrees, though the vertex is partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration map; distinct peaks and valleys observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with an average peak height of approximately 3-8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The leading edges exhibit a convex curve tapering towards sharp distal points; the trailing edges follow a generally symmetrical concave trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters on the left distal tip and scattered across the medial-lateral regions of the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple unaligned linear pixel disruptions (white on black) consistent with rake marks or superficial scratches on both the left and right ventral surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring across the ventral surface, particularly concentrated along the trailing margins; no visible amputations or major structural trauma to the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion at the lower central fluke-water interface caused by high-velocity water droplets and aeration (spray).
